data.one_liner: A very fast link-checker that crawls websites and checks integrity of links in HTML and CSS.
data.what_it_does: Crawls static or local sites to check the integrity of links in HTML and CSS files. It detects broken links, missing anchors, and reports warnings or errors with specific line and column locations.
use_when: You want to run link checking on your CI or before every deployment
You need to check static sites or local development servers for broken links and missing anchors
avoid_when: You need to validate Single Page Applications (SPAs) that require rendering JavaScript
You need to validate non-HTTP/HTTPS protocols such as FTP or telnet
strengths: Significantly faster than many alternative link checkers
Correctly parses both HTML and CSS for URLs
Provides brief and meaningful output with POSIX compliance and CI exit codes
weaknesses: Does not attempt to render JavaScript
Does not validate non-HTTP/HTTPS link schemes like FTP or mailto
data.setup_notes: Can be downloaded directly, run via Docker, or activated globally via Dart pub (`dart pub global activate linkcheck`).
